ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious DumpMinitool Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious ways to use the "DumpMinitool.exe" binary

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\DumpMinitool\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\DumpMinitool\\\.x86\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\DumpMinitool\\\.arm64\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "DumpMinitool\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "DumpMinitool\.x86\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "DumpMinitool\.arm64\.exe")) AND (( NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\ Visual\\ Studio\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Extensions\\\\.*")))) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.txt.*") OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ Full.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ Mini.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ WithHeap.*")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-dumpType.*"))))
